types.name: Hydropower plant
types.description: Hydropower stations (reservoir, run-of-river) with ≥ 50 MW installed capacity, in operation. Capacity is what the turbines can deliver, not what they produce in a year.

types.name: Nuclear power plant
types.description: Nuclear reactors in operation (units at one site combined). Retired reactors (Barsebäck, Ringhals 1–2, Oskarshamn 1–2, Ågesta) are excluded.

types.name: Wind farm (onshore)
types.description: Onshore wind farms with ≥ 50 MW installed capacity.

types.name: Offshore wind farm
types.description: Offshore wind farms in operation (all sizes).

types.name: Thermal power plant
types.description: Combustion plants ≥ 50 MW (coal, gas, oil, biomass, waste), often combined heat and power for district heating.

types.name: Oil & gas field
types.description: Producing fields on the Norwegian continental shelf, at the centre of the field outline, with saleable production in the latest complete year (million standard m³ of oil equivalents). Danish North Sea fields are not included (no open field-level dataset was reachable).

types.name: Metal mine
types.description: Sweden: entries of SGU's mineral resources database classed 'mine/quarry' with a metallic main type (sulphide, iron oxide, precious metal). 'Producing' when SGU's production field says so. Norwegian mines are not included (the NGU service was not reachable).

types.name: Industrial mineral mine
types.description: Sweden: SGU 'mine/quarry' entries of industrial minerals (limestone, dolomite, quartz, feldspar…).
